headline: US stocks set to open higher as weak July payrolls ease Fed hike worries and refocus trading on tech and rate-sensitive sectors
raw_text:
- S&P 500 (@ES), Nasdaq 100 (@NQ), Dow (@YM), and Russell 2000 (@ER2) futures trade higher pre-market, with Nasdaq futures outperforming after softer July employment data.
- July nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly decline by 23K versus expectations for an 80K-plus increase, while unemployment holds near 4.1%, easing immediate rate-hike concerns and reinforcing a more dovish Fed path.
- Cloudflare (NET) climbs in pre-market trade after beating Q2 expectations and raising 2026 guidance, citing strong AI-related demand.
- Airbnb (ABNB) advances pre-market after raising its 2026 outlook to at least mid-teens revenue growth.
- Microchip Technology (MCHP), Akamai (AKAM), and Equinix (EQIX) trade notably higher pre-market on company-specific catalysts amid broad strength in technology and data-center names.
- ResMed (RMD) falls after issuing a softer FY27 outlook, while Sweetgreen (SG) declines after cutting its 2026 outlook amid cyclosporiasis concerns.
- Overnight earnings reactions in Airbnb (ABNB) and Cloudflare (NET) help lift related travel, software, and AI-exposed names.
- Asian equity markets are mixed with modest losses in Japan’s Nikkei, while European indices trade slightly higher.
- With July payrolls now out and no other major US data on today’s calendar, traders focus on key S&P 500 (@ES) technical levels and potential intraday volatility in AI, software, and other rate-sensitive sectors.
